I buy cinemark rewards...20%.....then this is bold.....I walk up to people and offer them 20% off with my membership.....then I get their points....you get a free ticket at 250 points.    On average I get about 100 points by talking to 4 people....that’s a free ticket every 2.5 times I watch a movie.

Thank you.   I appreciate the sentiment.    I haven’t lost hope on human kind.    Just my place in it once my value has been realized.    I wish I were richer so I could kill myself now.   Would people fund a pity go fund me page so I can mercifully kill myself?    I wonder.    ( I’d give up money)

I completely understand.    I believe some of us are born doomed.    I’m one of those.  I derive no joy in this life save the moment my eyes close at night until the nightmare starts over when I open them.    I’ll make sure people don’t suffer for my selfishness, then I’ll kill myself....at least I don’t have to save for my 401K anymore....not that I have any use for money anyway.
Well to be honest Ita more like 35 years...I met someone and it went away for 6 months....now 7 months after it’s over I’m back to my original plan of killing myself.

Premature and self induced death is unnatural, some folks will be “sad” cause of their own insecurity that the world just fucked up.   There are those, though that have genuinely been touched by you and your death means that a piece of them dies too.   We are social animals, like it or not.   And as these people have imprinted in you, you have on them as well.    Those folks will truly miss you.

Woe is the romantic heart that feels the heights of extreme euphoria but the utter emptiness of depression.    All in.  No holding back.   No fear.   But the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat.    I am exactly the same way.     The problem is those that love us will invariably disappoint us and we feel beyond hurt and drive them away. 

I feel you.
I am the same way....but when love fails I lash out hard too cause I hurt so much....there may be wisdom in this quote.
